verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a public 'API Access & Keys' feature and a Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide, indicating a documented API and extensibility surface for programmatic control, but probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of API completeness or robustness. Missing for 10: verifiable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent developer confirmation of API usage, and broader documentation depth beyond a single docs page.
